author: GamingBolt
description:
Gamescom's Opening Night Live has concluded, and to be fair, it was a rather mixed showcase. It didn't particularly have any major surprises; most of the major announcements were already known before hand. 

Regardless, there were some decent reveals and in this video we will talk about the 15 biggest ones. So, let's get started.
title: Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 - 15 HUGE Game Announcements You Likely Missed

author: GamingBolt
description:
Every year, annual sports titles promise to take a leap forward, but which changes actually matter? NBA 2K27 introduces substantial gameplay revisions, yes, but the overriding feeling with this year’s entry is authenticity. 

From more responsive movement to refined shooting mechanics and revamped defence, NBA 2K27 is set to boost realism over last year’s version – here’s 15 differences between this year and last that you need to know.
title: NBA 2K27 vs NBA 2K26 - 15 MAJOR Differences

author: GamingBolt
description:
Years and years of waiting have finally brought us to Insomniac Games' latest, and goriest, title to date in Marvel's Wolverine. Launching on September 15th exclusively for PS5 at $69.99, it stars everyone's favorite anti-hero, James “Logan” Howlett, as he does what he does best: Save mutants and take on anyone who looks at him funny. Which is a surprisingly large number of people in this game.

Boasting several firsts from Insomniac, Marvel's Wolverine offers an action-adventure unlike its previous titles. We've boiled down 15 different things you need to know about Logan's brutal new tale, starting with a refreshing revelation.

Credit: Some footage was used from: Punish/BlueThunderReal.
title: Marvel's Wolverine PS5 - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
